rows.grounds: Surface 'tadantarnavamānevā', gloss 'that-within-navel-measure-or'. Analyzable as tat-antar-nava-mānena ('by that measure within the navel') with indeclinable vā ('or'); sandhi/segmentation AMBIGUOUS (mānena vā vs. māna-eva).

Surface 'pādāṣṭāṃśonvitothavā', gloss 'foot-eighth-part-joined-or'. Analyzable as pāda-aṣṭāṃśa-anvitaḥ ('joined with an eighth part of a foot/division'; pāda per ledger = division, but literal 'foot' possible in measurement context) with indeclinable athavā ('or'); sandhi unvitaḥ+athavā.
